name: Hitshot
subtitle: Music trivia with friends
shortDescription: Build playlists, place songs on the timeline, and challenge your friends.
description: Hitshot turns music knowledge into a fast social party game. Create or join a room, choose a curated or custom deck, listen together, place tracks on a timeline, name songs, challenge close calls, and finish with a shareable result. Guest play, QR joining, reconnect recovery, public TV mode, and accessible host controls keep every group in the game.
reviewNotes: Use guest entry for review. Spotify is optional; preview fallback supports the complete review journey without an external playback account.
releaseNotes: Initial mobile release with party matches, custom decks, provider fallback, host recovery, TV projection, and accessible iPhone and Android play.
